title: The Promise and the Theft
logline: Firuz comes home, returns to the princess and hides the flying horse in her garden; the inventor, who overheard everything, arrives with a caravan, tricks the princess into the saddle and flies away with her, leaving only a scrap of his saffron turban.
moral: A liar who knows true things is the most dangerous kind; and a promise is kept by going after what was taken.
tone: Bright adventure serial: warm homecoming, a villain who rehearses his own trick (comic, then chilling when it works), a held ending. 80s cel anime: wide detailed sets, characters on twos, one impact frame.

beats.summary: Firuz comes home; the king and the household celebrate.
He tells the story of the lever and the far land; the inventor listens from behind a cypress (plant).
Days later he returns to the princess with the password; her family receives him.
She chooses to visit his country later, by land, with an escort.
The horse carries only two: the trunk slides off.
Firuz hides the horse in the garden and leaves to arrange the journey.
The inventor is on the road with a caravan: he knows where to go.
A saffron turban rises behind the hedge, right behind the princess.
THE PLAN: in his imagination the lie works at once.
In the plan the horse flies before she can get down, and he refuses to return.
The real attempt: the cat hisses, she backs away, he has to work.
She doubts him; the two controls, which are real, win her trust.
He scrambles up behind her and turns the knob.
Impact frame: the horse shoots up; the cat tears a scrap from the turban.
TAKE ME BACK! NO! He will not listen.
Firuz finds neither horse nor princess.
The saffron scrap: he understands the trick.
His promise to the sky: I will bring them back safely. To be continued.

subtitles.ar: عاد فيروز إلى قصر أبيه بعد أيام من الغياب، ففرح الملك وأهل القصر بسلامته.|حكى لهم كيف اكتشف ذراع الهبوط، وكيف وصل إلى بلاد بعيدة فوق الغيوم.
subtitles.en: Firuz returned to his father’s palace after days away, and the king and his household celebrated his safety.|He told them how he found the descent lever and reached a distant land above the clouds.

subtitles.ar: استقبلته الأميرة، وتحدثا مع أسرتها.|اختارت أن تزور بلاده لاحقًا مع حاشية تسافر برًا؛ فالحصان لا يحمل إلا راكبين.
subtitles.en: The princess welcomed him, and they spoke with her family.|She chose to visit his country later with an overland escort, since the horse carried only two.

subtitles.ar: أخفى فيروز الحصان في حديقة القصر، وذهب لترتيب الرحلة.|وكان المخترع قد عرف وجهته من حديثه،|فسافر إليها برًا مع قافلة، ووصل سرًا.
subtitles.en: Firuz hid the horse in the palace garden and went to arrange the journey.|The inventor had learned his destination from his conversation,|so he traveled there secretly by land with a caravan.

subtitles.ar: قال المخترع للأميرة: «أرسلني فيروز لأشرح لك الحصان قبل عودتك».|شكّت فيه، لكنه عرض المقبضين وقال إن الأمير ينتظر قريبًا.
subtitles.en: The inventor told the princess, “Firuz sent me to explain the horse before your return.”|She doubted him, but he showed the controls and said the prince was nearby.

subtitles.ar: جلست الأميرة لتتعلم، فركب المخترع خلفها وأدار المقبض.|طار الحصان قبل أن تنزل، فطلبت منه العودة، لكنه رفض.
subtitles.en: The princess sat down to learn, but the inventor climbed behind her and turned the control.|The horse flew before she could dismount. She asked him to return, but he refused.

subtitles.ar: اقترب المخترع من الأميرة وقال: «أرسلني فيروز لأشرح لك طريقة ركوب الحصان قبل السفر».|شكّت في كلامه، لكنه أراها المقبضين، وأكد أن الأمير ينتظرهم قريبًا.
subtitles.en: The inventor approached the princess. “Firuz sent me to show you how to ride before the journey,” he claimed.|She doubted him, but he demonstrated the two controls and insisted the prince was waiting nearby.

subtitles.ar: جلست الأميرة على الحصان لتتعلم،|فركب المخترع خلفها وأدار المقبض فجأة.|طار الحصان بسرعة قبل أن تنزل، وصاحت تطلب العودة، لكنه رفض أن يستمع إليها.
subtitles.en: The princess mounted the horse to learn,|but the inventor climbed behind her and suddenly turned the control.|The horse flew before she could dismount; she cried out for him to return, but he refused.

subtitles.ar: عاد فيروز إلى الحديقة، فلم يجد الحصان ولا الأميرة.|رأى على الأرض قطعة من عمامة المخترع، وفهم أن الخديعة بدأت.|نظر إلى السماء وقال: «سأعيدهما بأمان».
subtitles.en: Firuz returned to the garden but found neither horse nor princess.|He saw a piece of the inventor’s turban on the ground and realized a trick was underway.|Looking skyward, he said, “I will bring them back safely.”

owner_questions: SCRIPT: paragraphs 6 and 7 tell the same events as paragraphs 4 and 5 a second time (in both languages); default: P4 and P5 are staged as the inventor's imagined PLAN in a large thought cloud while he hides behind the hedge, and P6 and P7 as the real event, with the narration unchanged (alternative: cut P4 and P5, or P6 and P7, from the narration).

SCRIPT: small differences between the languages are kept verbatim: English P3 moves "secretly" onto the journey (Arabic: "and arrived secretly"), English P6 adds "he claimed", English P7 omits "quickly" and "to listen to her", English P2 says "carried only two" where the Arabic says "two riders".
The inventor is shown eavesdropping from behind a cypress while Firuz tells his story at 9.0 to 17.7 (the script only says he learned the destination from Firuz's talk); default: keep the plant.

P2 is staged on the palace roof at golden dusk: Firuz gives the episode 2 password THE MOON KNOWS THE RIVER'S PATH, and her father (royal blue and silver, as planned for episode 4), her mother, the two guards and the maid appear; default: keep.
The two-seat line is shown with counters 1 and 2 over the saddle and the maid's trunk sliding off the horse (ONLY TWO SEATS!); default: keep this small joke.
Firuz hides the horse under a striped carpet cloth in a rose bower; the princess mounts from a small footstool that the inventor provides; default: keep both.
The script does not say how the piece of turban came to lie on the ground: default is that the roof cat from episode 2 claws the turban tail at take-off (RIP!) and later shows the scrap to Firuz.

The abduction is softened: the inventor never touches the princess, she is angry and active (TAKE ME BACK!, looking for the lever), and his refusal is NO! with a finger in his ear; default: keep it light.

Invented English balloons and tags: MY SON!, I WILL COME BY LAND, ONLY TWO SEATS!, THE INVENTOR, THE PLAN, FIRUZ SENT ME!, HEH HEH!, FIRUZ SENT ME TO TEACH YOU!, UP, DOWN, THE PRINCE WAITS NEARBY!, RIP!, TAKE ME BACK!, NO!, I WILL BRING THEM BACK SAFELY! (short versions of the quoted lines where the script quotes); default: keep all 18 items including the two titles.
In the imagined plan the "prince waiting nearby" is drawn as a cardboard cut-out of Firuz on a stick, to show that it is a lie; default: keep.

At the end Firuz ties the saffron scrap into his crimson sash, to be carried into episodes 4 and 5; the film ends on TO BE CONTINUED... with the Arabic title line shown only on the opening title; default: keep.

Time of day: home palace in the morning, the roof at golden dusk after DAYS LATER..., the garden scenes on a bright morning and the ending at golden hour the same day (no night scenes in this episode); default: as described.
